Hero.subtitle: Experience authentic celebrations with a modern twist. From small village festivals to exclusive event gastronomy – we bring the traditional host into the present.

About.title: Welcome to Maurerwirt!
About.subtitle: Bavarian Roots. Modern Celebrations.
About.p1: I am Florian Maurer – known to many simply as "Maurerwirt". With roots in the Halbauer butchery, I learned early on what quality and genuine hospitality mean. Today, I bring this tradition into the modern event world.
About.p2: Whether it's a traditional folk festival, an elegant company anniversary, or a very personal club party – we combine Bavarian warmth with precise planning and professional equipment.
About.quote: "A good party doesn't plan itself, but it should feel like it does."
About.p3: Let's work together to create an event that your guests will remember fondly for a long time.
